meta.title: DameJustice: the sovereign legal document assistant, 100% on-premise
meta.description: DameJustice searches your firm's contracts, leases and archives directly on your own servers, even offline. Every answer cites its exact source. No document ever leaves the firm.

preview.homeTitle: What are you looking for in your archives?
preview.homeSubtitle: Ask your legal question. Your documents stay with you, in your firm.
preview.question: What strategy did we adopt in the Martin v. Durand case?
preview.answer: In the Martin v. Durand case (2021), the firm adopted a strategy based on challenging territorial jurisdiction, arguing that there was no sufficient connection with the area covered by the court seized. This argument was well received at first instance, before being partially called into question on appeal.
preview.caption: Application preview: a question asked about the Martin v. Durand case, a written answer and three sources cited with their page number.

onPremise.title: Your confidential files never leave your premises.
onPremise.subtitle: For total confidentiality, DameJustice is installed directly within your organisation as a dedicated secure appliance.
onPremise.imageAlt: The DameJustice secure appliance, installed on your premises.

cards.title: Absolute professional secrecy
cards.text: Your briefs, contracts, deeds and case files stay with you. No data passes through an external cloud.

cards.title: Ready to use
cards.text: The appliance plugs straight into your local network. Every lawyer on your team can access it immediately from their own workstation.

cards.title: Instant search
cards.text: Find a clause, a precedent or an analysis across all your archives in a fraction of a second.

onPremise.note: Our team installs, configures and maintains the appliance remotely. No technical skills are required on your side.

demo.title: See DameJustice work on your own documents.
demo.text: A 30-minute demonstration, with a sample corpus or your own, on a machine disconnected from the network if you wish. We then discuss your infrastructure and your confidentiality requirements.
